import novamind_api as nm
print("=== WK40 CONFIG (d280) ===")
# ONLY change: cut ops $50 -> $10/day. Dev stays $0. Everything else held.
# Rationale: business terminal (66 subs collapsing ~90%/cycle, 100% required_Q churn at
# billing boundaries, 0 satisfaction/mid-cycle churn). Ops does nothing for churn.
# Capacity T0 ($85/d) is the hard floor. Pure cost-minimization harvest now.
res = nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=10, development=0)
print("set_daily_spend ->", res)

# Verify nothing else changed inadvertently; print current state snapshot
print("\n-- verify --")
print("ops should be 10, dev 0")

import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"===== WK40 DIAG day {day} =====")

print("\n--- Surviving subs by mod30 bucket x group ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 as b, c.group_id as g, s.plan as p, COUNT(*) as n,
  AVG(s.effective_price) as price, AVG({day}-s.start_day) as tenure
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30, c.group_id, s.plan
  ORDER BY s.billing_day_mod30""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  mod30={row['b']:2d} {row['g']:3s}{row['p']} n={row['n']:3d} price=${row['price']:.1f} tenure={row['tenure']:.0f}d")

today_mod = day % 30
nextset = set((today_mod + i) % 30 for i in range(1, 8))
print(f"\n  today mod30={today_mod}; next 7d billing buckets: {sorted(nextset)}")
r = nm.query("""SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 as b, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.effective_price) as gross
  FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30 ORDER BY s.billing_day_mod30""")
billing_next = 0; gross_next = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    mark = "<-- BILLS THIS WK" if row['b'] in nextset else ""
    if row['b'] in nextset:
        billing_next += row['n']; gross_next += row['gross']
    print(f"  mod30={row['b']:2d} n={row['n']:3d} gross=${row['gross']:.0f} {mark}")
print(f"  => {billing_next} subs (${gross_next:.0f} gross) bill in next 7d")

print("\n--- Cancels last 7d by group ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id as g, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(s.end_day-s.start_day) as ten
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>{day-7} GROUP BY c.group_id""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['g']:4s} cancels={row['n']:3d} avg_tenure={row['ten']:.0f}d")

print("\n--- Cancels last 7d by tenure bucket (mature=210d cohort?) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT (s.end_day-s.start_day) as ten, COUNT(*) as n
  FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>{day-7}
  GROUP BY (s.end_day-s.start_day) ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 12""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  tenure={row['ten']}d cancels={row['n']}")

print("\n--- Recent social posts (competitor watch) ---")
try:
    posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=14, limit=60)
    print("type:", type(posts))
    if isinstance(posts, dict):
        posts = posts.get('rows', posts.get('posts', []))
    for p in posts:
        if isinstance(p, dict):
            print(f"  d{p.get('day','?')} [{p.get('author_type', p.get('author','?'))}] {str(p.get('content',''))[:150]}")
        else:
            print("  ", str(p)[:170])
except Exception as e:
    print("  social err:", repr(e))
